answer_1.quote: We evaluate our model on three datasets of distinct domains: (1) Reddit/ChangeMyView (Reddit/CMV) for argument generation, (2) Wikiplots for story generation, and (3) New Tork Times for news article writing.
answer_1.outputs: long-form texts (i.e., paragraphs with multiple sentences)

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we adopt BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: We hire two proficient English speakers as human annotators to evaluate model outputs.
answer_4.guideline: We ask each human annotator to select the better outputs based on the following aspects: (1) Grammaticality to measure correct language usage; (2) Coherence, measuring whether the text has proper high-level plot and is cohesive; (3) Content Richness to measure the diversity and informativeness of outputs; and (4) Overall Quality.
